subject: Discovery recap + model recommendations and regression guardrails
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco@clearledger.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + model recommendations and regression guardrails

Hi Marco / Sara —

Thanks for the time today — good call. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can move to an eval without surprises. Highlights below; attaching the prompt examples and our Q1 bench for reference.

1) Primary goal: Improve invoice-extraction accuracy and downstream entity linking for your reconciliation flow (~95% precision target on top-5 fields).
2) Recommended model candidates for the eval: rdm-v2.3-quant (low-cost, strong structured-output extraction) and rdm-v3-llama-compat (higher recall, slightly higher latency).
3) Benchmarks: baseline on your sample (n=2k rows) shows v2.3-quant hit ~92% on our internal extractor test; v3 variant trades +3% recall but introduces occasional hallucinated fields in long invoices. Link: https://redwood.ai/benchmarks/qa-suite-2026
4) Prompt set: included in clearledger_prompt_examples_v1.json — we recommend testing both a constrained system message and one permissive assistant-style prompt to measure sensitivity.

Regression guardrails we discussed — important given you run nightly model refreshes:
- Emergency pin: ability to pin the deployment to a known-good model version (we can restrict to a project/test namespace).
- Canary + auto-rollback: run 10% traffic against candidate for 2 hours; if key metric (top-5 field precision) drops >2.5pp, auto-roll back.
- Diff alerts: token-level and output-diff summaries posted to the Console with examples.

Action items:
- From ClearLedger: share 2k anonymized invoices and the schema you care about (Marco / Sara).
- From Redwood: provision a test project, run bench against v2.3-quant and v3 quickly, and propose canary thresholds for your account.

I recommend we schedule a 45-minute follow-up on Wednesday to review bench results and agree canary thresholds. Ben / Monica, please confirm availability for an ops/SE-focused call.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: clearledger_prompt_examples_v1.json (application/json)
Attachment: clearledger_bench_report_Q1_2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marco Ruiz <marco@clearledger.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearledger.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + model recommendations and regression guardrails

Tessa —

Thanks for the recap and clear asks. We can send a sanitized set by EOD tomorrow. Two things I want to call out from our side:

1) We recently saw a regression after a model roll that changed how certain vendor names were normalized — it increased manual-review work by ~9% on a small QA sample. That makes the canary/rollback idea mandatory for us.
2) We need clarity on who on our side can trigger an emergency pin (SRE vs product manager). Ideally product triggers, SRE approves.

Immediate asks for Redwood: can you run a quick diff between the production model (prod-rdm-v2.2-stable) and the proposed v2.3-quant on our sample and surface the top 10 record-level differences? If we can see examples up-front, we can decide whether to pin or allow canary.

Marco Ruiz
Head of Product, ClearLedger
marco@clearledger.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco@clearledger.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + model recommendations and regression guardrails

Marco —

Quick technical reply: we can absolutely produce a prioritized diff report (record-level examples + token diffs) between prod-rdm-v2.2-stable and rdm-v2.3-quant on your sample. Plan:

- Run both models over the shared 2k set (sanitized); compute field-level deltas and precision/recall per vendor and invoice-size buckets.
- Generate the top-10 examples where extracted outputs differ and include the exact prompts used (from your attached prompt set).
- Produce a suggested canary policy: 10% traffic, 2-hour warm-up, rollback if top-5 precision drops >2.0 percentage points. This is slightly tighter than the 2.5pp suggested, given your production sensitivity.

Options to mitigate without immediate rollback:
- Apply a lightweight post-hoc validation layer (rule-based or small reranker) that filters low-confidence fields before they reach reconciliation.
- Pin only the production namespace to v2.2-stable and run the canary in a parallel test namespace where we can iterate faster.

If you want an emergency pin now, I can request the ops team to hold new model promotions for your org while we run the diff — that requires confirmation from a ClearLedger product owner.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: quick-diff-plan.txt (text/plain)
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CL-2026-048

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marco Ruiz <marco@clearledger.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + model recommendations and regression guardrails

Thanks all — next steps confirmed:

- Marco / Sara: please upload the sanitized 2k file to the Drive link (or share access) by tomorrow morning.
- Redwood (Ben / Monica): run v2.2-stable vs v2.3-quant diff and return top-10 record-level differences + suggested canary thresholds by EOD Tuesday. Include sample prompts and a short runbook for emergency pin.
- Decision flow: product owner at ClearLedger confirms emergency pin; SRE will be notified to approve pin action in Console. We'll capture this in the mutual action plan.
- Scheduling: propose Wed 2026-06-03 10:00 AM PT for a 45-min bench review. Ben / Monica, please hold.

If the diff shows >2.0pp degradation on the top-5 precision metric, we will default to pinning production to v2.2-stable and run v2.3-quant in parallel test namespace until fixes are implemented. If degradation is small but concentrated on certain vendors, we will add the reranker + targeted prompt guards and re-run the canary.

Thanks — I will capture these items in the HubSpot plan (CL-2026-048) and share the drive link for uploads.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123
